statement: In the case of GG circuits, the proof is analogous but we further need to restrict to encodings that map the input x to GG circuit parameters with fixed combination coefficients. Finally, note that the class of polynomial encodings covers several cases of interest, since polynomials of arbitrary degree can be used to approximate any desired function. We believe that similar results can be obtained for larger classes of encoding functions, e.g., neural networks, but leave this proof open for future works.
